title: Terminal node vector-field address
summary: Recovered VA 0x457f70 as a thiscall Node member: follow +0x1c0 links until null and return terminal+0x1b0. Original instructions and direct caller at 0x4980e3 confirm address-return behavior without memory writes.
test_description: Compare original thiscall oracle against member method for 65 standalone nodes, every suffix of permuted chains of lengths 1 through 65, shared suffixes and rewired terminals. Assert exact expected pointer and byte-for-byte preservation of all node storage after each call.
known_limits: Vector field contents and element type are unresolved and represented as opaque storage.
Valid finite null-ended chains only: null this and invalid links fault in original; cycles never terminate and are not executed in tests.
Original node size beyond the observed link and broader class identity are unresolved.
Readable behavior recovery; no byte-matching claim or full game validation.
